title: Liniment
summary: LIN'IMENT, noun [Latin linimentum. from linio, lino, to anoint.] A species of soft ointment; a composition of a consistence somewhat thinner than an unguent, but thicker than oil

inlines.v: LIN'IMENT, noun [Latin linimentum. from linio, lino, to anoint.] A species of soft ointment; a composition of a consistence somewhat thinner than an unguent, but thicker than oil
